text:
Which statement describes the effect of adding a catalyst to a chemical reaction?
A
The activation energy, Ea, of the reaction is increased.
The enthalpy change, ΔH, of the reaction stays unchanged.
B
C
The frequency of collisions between the particles is decreased.
D
The kinetic energy of the particles is increased.

options.label: A
options.text: The activation energy, Ea, of the reaction is increased.

options.label: B
options.text: The enthalpy change, ΔH, of the reaction stays unchanged.

options.label: C
options.text: The frequency of collisions between the particles is decreased.

options.label: D
options.text: The kinetic energy of the particles is increased.
